notes.title: Devlog #8:Sea battle and new demo update
notes.content:
Hey guys

For several weeks, we developing new system in Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare: Sea battle

So what's like sea battle in this game? This several screenshots how like the sea battle in this game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/0c46b12a40c6287192744bfd0961edef99563ac4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/b405927619c6867a6e017a475da4655cc788a75e.jpg[/img]
There are 4 orders in commanding ships:
1.Hit and run:attacking with arrows/guns/cannons(depends on technology ) and use speed of ships 
2.Boarding:attacking enemy by boarding to enemy ships and takeover each ships. This order very useful for large number of troop
3.Burning: burning ship and attacking it to enemy ship.
4.Flee:running from battle.

This is what we can tell for now.

New demo update has updated several days ago and have some new features.

For new update for main build the Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare, hope we can finish it before 24 November 2021.

Thank you.

notes.title: Devlog #6: New features in 1512 Campaign
notes.content:
Dear everyone 

Currently we prepare new update for historical campaign 1512. Unlike previous update, this update take long time. Probably in 14-15 November, the new update complated and uploaded in Steamworks.

Beside fixing many bugs, we add new features

[b]>New Port!  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/dd1baba1249515ee50cea76aa7a7e74cb874bed7.jpg[/img]
[b]1.Jepara[/b]
Jepara in 16th century was important harbor in Java. Near from Demak, Jepara plays critical position in new Sultanate of Demak with lord of Pati Unus, 2nd ruler of Demak, was ruler of Jepara (Crown Prince).

[b]2.Pasuruan[/b]
Pasuruan is Blambangan capital in early 16th century before push more eastern by Mataram. Pasuruan is the eastern border between Sultanate of Demak against Blambangan.

[b]>New unplayable factions[/b]

[b]1.Samudra Pasai[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/7b1df52f18cd857893254b44386e2924f66f83c7.jpg[/img]
Samudra Pasai is first sultanate in Indonesia's history located in Pasai, Aceh and become important port in Strait of Mallaca before Sultanate of Mallaca established Mallaca

[b]2.Negara Daha[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/d3a90a0d7d9f0730fe92bc511b7378dbb6bf0e6a.jpg[/img]
Before Sultanate of Banjarmasin, Negara Daha was notable kingdom in South Borneo and in middle 1512 campaign, Banjarmasin will appers as new kingdom and ask Demak to help them against Negara Daha in inner South Borneo!

[b]>New Features[/b]

1.[b]Europan's activity[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41043601/908ecac8259ba8beeaef3a25fcf5ed613068e85d.jpg[/img]
Portuguese and many Europans which permitted to stay in native factions can establish trading post, Jesuit's mission, or build the fort. This will impact many things like native conversion to catholic

So how about 1630 campaign? Yes, this campaign will get many update too including historical elements.

This is information we can reveal now.. Hope we can upload the new update soon.

Thank you
